== Summary ==
Original Japanese [[Imperial Squad Leader (Japanese ESB Two-Player)|Imperial Squad Leader]] from [[The Empire Strikes Back Introductory Two-Player Game (Japanese)]]. Card-face crop from [https://theswca.com/index.php?action=disp_item&item_id=100659 source], Japanese ESB Two-Player photograph.

Crop rectangle <code>(90, 50, 680, 930)</code> after applying the source orientation. Source SHA-256 <code>604cb5dfcad23b04a5be5867db5763349fdafae56412e9fe1d7910ea5736bcbf</code>. Lucasfilm Ltd. and Decipher Inc., 1998.
